name: Vital Strike — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Vital Strike from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Vital Strike (Combat)" but are not part of the Vital Strike entry, which is unchanged.

FAQ

Can Vital Strike be used with Spring Attack? Can Vital Strike be used on a charge?

No. Vital Strike can only be used as part of an attack action, which is a specific kind of standard action. Spring Attack is a special kind of full-round action that includes the ability to make one melee attack, not one attack action. Charging uses similar language and can also not be used in combination with Vital Strike.
